# datalink.ac

datalink is the spec and concept site for data links: a URL whose parameters carry
the complete data for rendering a picture. One link, one picture — the link is the
data. A human sees the rendering; an agent reads the numbers out of the link itself.

## For agents

- SKILL: https://datalink.ac/SKILL.md — how to write datalink URLs with the draw renderer.
- Examples (URL ↔ rendered pairs, a training corpus): https://datalink.ac/examples
- Spec (invariants, the agent contract, HTTP semantics): https://datalink.ac/spec
- Blog: https://datalink.ac/blog
- Reference renderer: https://x-cmd.com/draw — no account, no key; CLI and npm
  share the same parameters.

## The one rule

A datalink carries its data in its parameters. To change the picture, change the link.
